dataset: City of Vancouver Issued building permits
purpose: Technical false-negative backtest only. These permit-positive public records are not market-validation E3 evidence.
privacy_note: Residential addresses, applicants, contractors, emails and phone numbers are intentionally omitted. Permit numbers and summarized scopes remain for reproducibility against the public City dataset.

cases.scope_summary: Residential alteration: add walls to enclose a study as a bedroom, enlarge an existing window, replace/add doors and relocate laundry.
Convert a single detached house to a house with secondary suite, validate rear-deck covers and a small floor-area addition.
Construct a detached two-car garage at an existing single detached house.
Exterior alterations at a detached house including a cover over the existing rear deck, front-porch work, doors, windows and siding.
Commercial tenant improvement: remove and construct interior partitions, glazing and doors; renovate staff kitchen; electrical and sprinkler work.
Health-care office tenant improvement: remove partitions for a new layout and add new walls, plumbing, electrical and millwork.
Combine two office units by removing part of a demising wall and adding a new glass slider, plus electrical and sprinkler work.
Detached-house exterior/interior alteration with a rear floor-area addition, new dormer, secondary suite, covered porch, deck, roofing/cladding and relocated stairs.
Residential interior alteration limited in the public description to removal of interior finishes.
Interior alterations to improve an existing single detached house; public description does not enumerate the detailed alteration triggers.
